use_case_summary: Primary: in-app AI assistant (chat + follow-up generation) and document search with reranking. Embeddings used for semantic search and user-personalization. Expect mixture of short control prompts and multi-turn generation. Important: function/tool calling for structured outputs, streaming support for UI UX.
poc_results: Hosted API trial duration: 3 weeks (Jan 22 - Feb 12).
Observed averages: 18k total requests/week; 65% embedding-related requests, 25% chat generation, 10% misc (summarization/similarity).
Latencies (hosted API): median generation latency 210ms (single-turn), p95 740ms under trial traffic, embedding median 80ms, p95 260ms.

Token mix (sample week): avg generation tokens per chat response 150 tokens; prompt overhead avg 40 tokens; embeddings calls tokenized payload ~30 tokens per call. Estimated monthly token consumption ~18M generation tokens + 9M embedding tokens at current usage.
Error rate: 0.6% transient 5xx during one peak (investigated; likely throttling from client side on retries).
Cost observed (hosted): ~ $8k for trial month extrapolation at current volume (no committed discount).
traffic_forecast: Baseline (1x): chat QPS 6 avg, chat concurrency target 12 (avg session bursts). Embeddings QPS 28 avg, embeddings concurrency 40 with batching windows (50-200ms).
Peak (1.5x observed week-of-month): chat QPS 12, concurrency 25; embeddings QPS 70, concurrency 120 during morning syncs.
6-month growth assumption: 3x traffic -> plan for headroom: target Dedicated capacity for peak equivalent to 3x baseline (chat QPS 36, embeddings QPS 210).
Token mix forecast: generation tokens ~150 per chat call, prompt tokens + metadata 40. Embeddings calls token payload ~30; average tokens per end-user session ~350 tokens across multiple calls.
SLOs: p50 chat <200ms, p95 chat <300ms (goal), embedding p95 <250ms. Acceptable fallback policy: route to smaller cheaper model variant with graceful degradation under sustained overload.

Sizing asks for Redwood: provide mapping from target QPS/concurrency to GPU pool count for both low-latency chat model (redwood-llama-large-quant) and batched embedding runners. Include expected cost delta for 1x/3x/5x scenarios.
